$comment: The extras of omx-limiter's declaration: what its descriptor, omx-limiter.descriptor.json, has no word for (docs/declaration-as-descriptor.md). The two are the folder's hand-written files; tools/gen.mjs generates the rest and writes the travels the descriptor's links resolve to. Its parameters are by reference to omx-contract's limiter kernel and bind by name to omx-dsp's instance face. Control order, the descriptor's, is append-only.

console.$comment: The OpenMixer console draws its precision limiter on buses and mains only, as the chain's fixed tail after the plugin rack: the limiter panel (ceilingDb, lookaheadMs, releaseMs, then GR and true-peak readouts the contract does not declare yet). Its chip is an engage lamp with no text; it has no overview card.
